findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, email_check_full, pdf_to_text, image_ocr, web_to_markdown, web_read_full, url_metadata, x402_endpoint_check, x402_seller_audit, email_check_batch, invoice_intake · Private data: pdf_to_text, document_extract, domain_lookup, file_convert, token_info, x402_endpoint_check, invoice_intake, token_preflight, wallet_balance · Public sink: email_check, email_check_full, email_check_batch, invoice_intake, ens_resolve · Destructive: pdf_to_text, file_convert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, email_check_full, pdf_to_text, image_ocr, web_to_markdown, web_read_full, url_metadata, x402_endpoint_check, x402_seller_audit, email_check_batch, invoice_intake · Private data: pdf_to_text, document_extract, domain_lookup, file_convert, token_info, x402_endpoint_check, invoice_intake, token_preflight, wallet_balance · Public sink: email_check, email_check_full, email_check_batch, invoice_intake, ens_resolve · Destructive: pdf_to_text, file_convert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
